carousel.excerpt: The IT services giant launches its CAX Studio to help enterprises deploy AI-driven consumer engagement across the value chain, building on a string of agentic AI initiatives in 2026.
carousel.image_caption: A technology park in Hyderabad, India. Tech Mahindra has launched its Consumer Agentic Experience Studio in the city to drive AI-powered consumer value chain transformation.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian IT services companies are leading the global push into agentic AI, with implications for diaspora professionals in technology consulting and enterprise AI roles worldwide.

carousel.title: Why Value Investors Are Watching Infosys Ahead of Q1 Results
carousel.excerpt: With the stock trading near 52-week lows and a Zacks 'Buy' rating, Infosys presents a compelling valuation case — but headwinds from tariff uncertainty and deal ramp-downs complicate the picture.
carousel.image_caption: The Infosys campus in Bangalore, India. The IT major reports Q1 FY27 results on July 23 amid heightened investor scrutiny of its valuation metrics.
carousel.nri_angle: Infosys is among the most widely held Indian stocks by diaspora investors through its NYSE-listed ADR (INFY). Its valuation metrics and upcoming earnings carry direct portfolio implications for NRIs and Indian-origin investors globally.
